Fixes the output of the timestep of the TOTP export

When running

  privacyidea-token-janitor find --type totp --action export --csv

This is due to there is no "timestep" in token_dict.
So we pull the "timeStep" from the
token_dict.get("info_list").

This way we have all token information to use the csv export
for later import.

subject: Handle undefined action values in JS
message:
Handle undefined action values in JS

In case of an unknown action value which isn't in the `allowedValues`
list, the processing of the action failed and the policy action list
isn't rendered properly.
Ignoring an unknown action value fixes this.
This was the case i.e. when `email` was added to the
`challenge_response` action value in a version < v3.9 but the
email-token is a challenge-response token by default and thus was
removed from the list of token types where challenge-response was an
alternative.

subject: Remove space before regtoken on double-click copy
message:
Remove space before regtoken on double-click copy

When the registration token is double-clicked and copied, a space is
added to the front of string in the clipboard, leading to " TOKEN"
instead of "TOKEN". When copied blindly (e.g. during testing),

affected by this!).
We check the given keywords if the exist in the mapping and if the
requested columns do exist in the user table in the db.

since there could be multiple resolvers to check.

- Added new CSS classes for content layout and table container to improve styling.
- Implemented computed property in AuthService to determine self-service user status.

subject: fix: restore correct behavior after getParam → get_required/get_optional migration radiustoken: get_required raised on empty strings (e.g. radius.server=""), but the original getParam(optional=False) only raised for absent keys. Switch radius.server/radius.secret back to get_optional and keep the post-check that validates the radius.server+secret OR system_settings combination. radiustoken: get_optional(default=False) returns False (not None like the old getParam did), causing add_tokeninfo to store the string "False" which is truthy.  Fix by using get_optional without a default (returns None when absent) and wrapping the system_radius_settings check in is_true() so both None and the string "False" are treated as falsy. emailtoken: get_required raised on empty email strings, but the original getParam(optional=False) allowed empty strings (it only raised for absent keys). Use allow_empty=True so enrollment still succeeds when the user has no email.
message:
fix: restore correct behavior after getParam → get_required/get_optional migration
radiustoken: get_required raised on empty strings (e.g. radius.server=""),
but the original getParam(optional=False) only raised for absent keys. Switch
radius.server/radius.secret back to get_optional and keep the post-check that
validates the radius.server+secret OR system_settings combination.
radiustoken: get_optional(default=False) returns False (not None like the old
getParam did), causing add_tokeninfo to store the string "False" which is
truthy.  Fix by using get_optional without a default (returns None when absent)
and wrapping the system_radius_settings check in is_true() so both None and the
string "False" are treated as falsy.
emailtoken: get_required raised on empty email strings, but the original
getParam(optional=False) allowed empty strings (it only raised for absent keys).
Use allow_empty=True so enrollment still succeeds when the user has no email.
